seo_title: Find First Generation Scholarships in the USA
seo_description: First generation scholarships in the USA with deadlines, award ranges, and requirement signals. Compare listings and apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for first generation students usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and subject areas before you can decide where to apply. This filtered slice brings those listings into one place so you can compare options that may fit high school seniors, current college students, graduate students, and some international or permanent resident applicants alongside US citizens. The programs below span themes like education, STEM, community, disability, arts, and other miscellaneous categories, so it is worth scanning beyond your major. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements are not identical. When a provider application path is available, ScholarshipTop includes it so you can move from shortlist to submission more easily.
